roles.name: Client
goals: Leave editing notes on selected photos.
Submit the final selection to the photographer.
Start over if needed after submission.

workflows.name: Find and inspect

steps.action: Search for 'WINDOW'
steps.result: Window Light is the only result

steps.action: Open Window Light and confirm title, category, and image match
steps.result: Photo detail screen displays selected photo, title, category, controls, and notes field

steps.action: Return to Gallery and confirm search remains
steps.result: Search term persists in input field

steps.action: Clear search and select Outdoor category
steps.result: Seven photos appear in the grid

workflows.success: Client successfully finds and inspects a photo using search and filters
workflows.failure: Search or filter does not update correctly or photo details do not match
workflows.recovery: Client clears search or resets filters, or refreshes the page to restore state

workflows.name: Select, annotate, and persist

steps.action: Begin in an empty Draft state
steps.result: My Selection shows empty state with return-to-Gallery action

steps.action: Open Golden Hour and add it to selection
steps.result: Golden Hour appears in My Selection, count updates

steps.action: Add note: 'Please soften the background.'
steps.result: Note saved locally without separate save button

steps.action: Add four other photos to selection
steps.result: Five photos selected, count updates everywhere

steps.action: Attempt to add a sixth photo
steps.result: Limit is enforced with accessible feedback

steps.action: Open My Selection and confirm the same five records and note
steps.result: Five photos displayed in original order with notes

steps.action: Reload page
steps.result: Selection and note persist across reload

workflows.success: Client selects, annotates, and persists five photos correctly
workflows.failure: Selection exceeds five, notes are lost on reload, or state is not preserved
workflows.recovery: Client removes a photo to make room, or reloads the page to restore state

workflows.name: Remove and replace

steps.action: Begin with five selected photos
steps.result: Five photos displayed in original order

steps.action: Remove one photo from My Selection
steps.result: Count updates everywhere, photo removed from selection

steps.action: Add a different photo
steps.result: New photo added to selection, count updates

steps.action: Confirm correct five in sample-data order
steps.result: Photos displayed in original order with updated selection

steps.action: Reopen removed photo and confirm any previously saved note remains
steps.result: Note restored when photo is reopened

workflows.success: Client removes and replaces a photo correctly while preserving notes
workflows.failure: Photo note is lost when replaced or selection order is incorrect
workflows.recovery: Client reopens the photo to restore note, or reloads page to reset state

workflows.name: Submit and lock

steps.action: With fewer than five selected, confirm submission cannot proceed
steps.result: Submission button disabled with explanation

steps.action: Select exactly five photos
steps.result: Five photos selected, submission becomes enabled

steps.action: Open submission dialog and cancel
steps.result: Nothing changes, selection remains unchanged

steps.action: Open submission dialog again and confirm
steps.result: Submission confirmation dialog appears with summary of five photos and notes

steps.action: Confirm Submitted status, timestamp, and correct five photos
steps.result: Submitted state is locked, selection and notes are frozen

steps.action: Verify shortlist and note editing are locked across screens
steps.result: No changes can be made to selection or notes

steps.action: Reload page
steps.result: Submitted state remains locked

workflows.success: Client submits selection correctly, and the state is locked across all screens
workflows.failure: Submission proceeds with fewer than five, or state is not locked after submission
workflows.recovery: Client selects exactly five photos and confirms submission again, or reloads page to reset state

workflows.name: Start over

steps.action: Begin in Submitted state
steps.result: Submitted status, timestamp, and five photos displayed

steps.action: Open Start over and cancel
steps.result: All submitted data remains unchanged

steps.action: Open Start over again and confirm
steps.result: Confirmation dialog appears explaining that it clears selection, notes, status, and timestamp

steps.action: Verify empty Draft selection and cleared notes
steps.result: Selection is reset to empty state with no notes

steps.action: Reload page
steps.result: Reset persists across reload

workflows.success: Client successfully starts over after submission, clearing all data correctly
workflows.failure: Data is not cleared or reset fails to persist across reload
workflows.recovery: Client cancels and retries the start-over action, or reloads page to restore state
